name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: Cooking and wilderness survival go hand in hand. A campsite needs a campfire, a skill culinary trainers traditionally teach.

faq.answer: In Shen'dar Village, Mendalass Tattermend teaches skinners to make a Camp Chair from harvested hides. It gives you a place to rest while camping in the wilds.

sections.body: You can shape hides from fallen beasts into more than armor. Mendalass Tattermend shows you how to make a portable Camp Chair, so you can rest in the wilds and regain your strength before battle.
sections.title: Comfort in the Wilds

sections.body: In Shen'dar Village, Mendalass Tattermend teaches proven skinners to make sturdy seats from collected pelts. Towns forbid camps within their limits. A campsite also needs a campfire, a skill local culinary instructors have traditionally taught.
sections.title: The Teachings of Shen'dar Village

summary: In Shen'dar Village, Mendalass Tattermend shows skinners how to prepare for rest in the wilds. The lesson joins skinning with survival and a place to sit at camp.
